# Dangling Pages Risk

The system allows for the existence of dangling wiki pages if the associated owner entity is removed but not deleted. This can lead to confusion or errors if outdated pages remain accessible but are no longer valid.

**Anchored to:**

- `knowledge_compiler/wiki/emitter.py` — `knowledge_compiler.wiki.emitter.WikiEmitter.emit`
